import { Controller, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import {
  MessagePattern,
  MicroserviceOptions,
  Payload,
  Transport,
} from '@nestjs/microservices';

// S0_SOURCE:microservices-orders-worker-consumer
throw new Error('S0 orders-worker consumer fixture must never execute');

@Controller()
export class OrdersWorkerController {
  @MessagePattern('orders.rebuild-index')
  rebuildOrderIndex(@Payload() payload: unknown): unknown {
    return payload;
  }
}

@Module({ controllers: [OrdersWorkerController] })
export class OrdersWorkerModule {}

async function bootstrap(): Promise<void> {
  await NestFactory.createMicroservice<MicroserviceOptions>(OrdersWorkerModule, {
    transport: Transport.RMQ,
    options: { queue: 'orders_jobs' },
  });
}

void bootstrap;
